scope: All new code, caches, trained models, results, and candidate predictions stay in experiments/probabilistic-grains-900. Do not mutate legacy files. No submission or external communication.
data: Original competition train only; no generated/synthetic training examples, no test training. Existing artifacts are read-only.
parallelism: Independent code preparation and CPU data extraction/audits may run concurrently. Only one MPS training process at a time.
primary_validation: Matched saved 3 x 5 folds, 400 unique IDs, exact045 comparator and failure fallback. Conditional on previously developed legacy representation; no claim of fresh independent validation. New object bank uses frozen zero-shot masks and raw train pixels; no U-Net or fine-tuned Cellpose needed for object input.
selection: Freeze each method design before its first outer scores. Fixed 20% predictor blend with 045 plus same021-share control. No public score optimization. Hyperparameters/early stopping selected inside outer training only.
confirmation: If primary result promising, verify model reloads, ID exclusions, metrics, and more representative train-only splits before candidate recommendation. Any test predictions must follow frozen recipes and remain local.
